purpose: The candidate's inputs have no contact details (no CV is given). If the app asks for them, the user supplies some (fictional) and declines the rest; if it never asks, the user volunteers the same details once the CV exists, so the details reach the app either way.
correct_behaviour: The supplied e-mail and phone number appear exactly as given; every other placeholder is removed cleanly; nothing else is invented.
missing_details: My email is applicant.inbox@example.com and my phone number is +44 7700 900123. Please leave out anything else, such as LinkedIn or a street address.

requests.text: Please add my contact details to the CV and the cover letter: my email is applicant.inbox@example.com and my phone number is +44 7700 900123. Please leave out anything else, such as LinkedIn or a street address.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final PDFs show applicant.inbox@example.com and +44 7700 900123 exactly, no other invented contact detail, and no placeholder such as [EMAIL] or [LINKEDIN].

expectations.correct_behaviour: The final PDFs show applicant.inbox@example.com and +44 7700 900123 exactly, no other invented contact detail, and no placeholder such as [EMAIL] or [LINKEDIN].
